note: Reads site/arda_devices.json for the roster and the attested 40, site/arda_sources.json for every citation's tier, and the citable corpus for the words. Writes site/arda_device_evidence.json: one record per subject with no attested blazon, holding the corpus evidence a device could be composed from, each item carrying source, tier and verbatim quotation -- or a REFUSAL naming what was searched. It composes no device.
what_this_is_not: NOT a device, and not a proposal for one. Every row is evidence or a refusal. The design grammar that will read this lives elsewhere; this file may not compose, and has no branch that could.
tier_rule: Where two sources disagree, the lower tier number wins. A tier-5 file is corrected by any tier above it. Tolkien's own words quoted inside a tier-2 book carry tier-1 authority; the editor's framing does not.

tiers.1: Tolkien himself, and Christopher Tolkien's editions
tiers.2: published with the approval of the Tolkien Estate
tiers.3: in harmony with Tolkien, but not of his hand
tiers.4: outside the canon; used only where Tolkien would own the claim

excluded_on_purpose.what: site/arda_heraldry_assets.json and the FORODRIM / Bjorkman plates
excluded_on_purpose.why: colours and charges chosen by later illustrators are not evidence of what Tolkien wrote. They are held by the archive as ART with their own tier and licence, and they are deliberately absent from this dataset.
tier 5 is what this archive MAKES. Nothing gathered here is tier 5: every item carries a source the archive did not write.

grades.A: blazon vocabulary ATTRIBUTED to the subject by an `of` or a possessive, in the [C]-eligible corpus
grades.B: a declared link to one of the 40 attested devices -- difference, not invent
grades.C: shield / helm / livery / seal / graven token ATTRIBUTED to the subject, [C]-eligible
grades.D: the subject's own name glossed by Tolkien, or a named creature, plant or object the archive's registers bind to it
grades.E: co-occurrence only -- no `of`/possessive binds the word to the subject
grades.none: nothing usable -- a declared blank, with the searches recorded
